definitions.short: Sedom , a place near the Dead Sea
definitions.full: H5467. Sedom סְדֹּם 89 proper name, of a location Sodom , important Canaanitish city named (usually) with Gomorrha ( עֲמֹרָה , q. v.); — ᵐ5 Ζόδομα (inflected Ζοδόμώ , Ζοδομοις ): — ׳ס (on formation compare Lag BN 54 ), Gen 13:10 , 12 , 13 7 t. Genesis 18, 19, + מְדֹ֫מָה ( ה locative) 10:19 ; 18:22 ; 19:1 (all J), + 8 t. Genesis 14; from 8th cent. onwards, used as illustrating ׳י s judgments, Amos 4:11 ; Isa 1:9 ; 13:19 ; Deut 29:22 ; Jer 49:18 ; 50:40 ; Zeph 2:9 ; Lam 4:6 ; as proverbial for open sin Isa 3:9 ; Jer 23:14 so metaphor ס ׳קְצִינֵי Isa 1:10 (i.e. rulers as corrupt as in Sodom), ס ׳גֶּמֶּן Deut 32:32 (i.e. wickedness like Sodom's); Judah compare with ׳ס to her disadvantage Ezek 16:46 , 48 , 49 , 53 , 55 , 56 . Site probably at south end of Dead Sea, where are now Jebel Usdum (southwest), and Zoar (southeast) compare Di Gen 19:20 ff. Rob BR ii. 187 ff. GASm Geogr. 505 ff. Blankenhorn ZPV xix (1896), 53 ff Bd Pal. 3, 146 Buhl Geogr. 117, 271, 274 . See also שִׂדִּים .
